verdict.why: The blob, json and junit reporters and --merge-reports now read and write under .vitest by default, so existing paths in CI stop matching.

draft.detail: By default the json report is written to .vitest/json/output.json.

test.error: FAIL: --reporter=json printed the report to stdout and wrote no .vitest/json/output.json

source.quote: Generates a report of the test results in a JSON format compatible with Jest's `--json` option. By default it is written to `.vitest/json/output.json`.
